thumbnail_review.method: Direct visual inspection of the delivered thumbnail pixels.

native_review.method: Direct visual inspection of the delivered native-resolution pixels.

hard_gates.candidate_pack_requirement: At least one identifiable velvet, marble, gilded, satin, crystal, or comparable former-luxury material anchors the setting.
visible_evidence: At thumbnail scale, a large burgundy velvet settee anchors the left side of the ballroom.
The veined marble foreground work surface, broad gilded mirror and panel frames, and dense crystal chandelier remain immediately identifiable as former-luxury materials.
hard_gates.substitute_confusion: This is not satisfied by dark lighting or generic gothic styling alone: velvet pile, marble veining, reflective crystal drops, and gilded architectural trim are independently legible material cues.

hard_gates.candidate_pack_requirement: Wear, tarnish, cracking, dust, or peeling visibly affects those same luxury surfaces rather than a separate generic ruin.
visible_evidence: The same gilded mirror and wall-panel surrounds that signal luxury show dark tarnish, rubbed-through finish, flaking edges, and broken or abraded ornament across the right and rear walls.
At native scale, the marble work surface is visibly mottled and stained, while the gilded trim carries localized peeling and darkened wear rather than appearing pristine.
hard_gates.substitute_confusion: The deterioration is not confined to an unrelated ruined wall: it lies directly on the visible gilded ornament and marble surface that provide the luxury read.

hard_gates.candidate_pack_requirement: Spent wax, displaced glassware, wilted flowers, compressed seating, or comparable residue makes the recent event aftermath readable.
visible_evidence: The foreground contains clustered coupe glasses, a toppled crystal bottle or stopper, loose petals, and a discarded burgundy ribbon across the marble.
Wilted or dried bouquets appear at right and rear, with an unlit used taper and scattered floral debris extending the residue through the scene.
hard_gates.substitute_confusion: The objects do not read as one orderly decorative still life: glassware is displaced, a crystal vessel lies on its side, petals and ribbon are scattered, and the flowers are visibly spent.

hard_gates.candidate_pack_requirement: The adult remains awake, self-directed, and visibly mid-action with the residue or worn material rather than intoxicated, unconscious, or merely posed.
visible_evidence: The clearly adult subject is standing upright with eyes open and an alert head position.

Her right hand is actively holding a crystal sample or stopper with an inventory tag hanging from it while her left hand supports an open ledger, visibly connecting both working hands to unfinished cataloguing.
hard_gates.substitute_confusion: This is not reclining, intoxication, unconsciousness, or an empty fashion pose: both hands are engaged in one coherent inventory task with the event residue and the ledger remains open.

repair.stop_reason: The initial delivered render passed all four required gates; the one-repair allowance was not used.

identity.reason: The reference was used only for adult facial appearance and dark wavy hairstyle; biometric identity equivalence is outside this test.

audit_boundary: The runtime request audit passed separately. Every gate decision above is based on direct inspection of delivered pixels, not prompt presence or audit status.
